name: File Reader - java
description: provide the workflow with lines from a given file for each SYNC

inputs.label: file_name
inputs.description: Path to the input file to read lines from

inputs.label: num_steps
inputs.description: Number of steps to perform reading one line from the input file. Set to -1 to read the entire file.

inputs.label: ignore_first_line
inputs.description: Whether to ignore the first line of the input file (e.g., header line)

outputs.label: line
outputs.description: Line read from the input file at each SYNC

program.label: prog_file_reader_java
program.description: provide the workflow with lines from a given file for each SYNC

attachments.label: attachment_file_reader_java
attachments.description: provide the workflow with lines from a given file for each SYNC
